content: The first feature length narrative film, The Story of the Kelly Gang, was made in Australia in 1906 and ran for about an hour.
The Wizard of Oz was one of the first major films to use Technicolor extensively, transitioning from black and white to vivid color once Dorothy arrives in Oz.
Alfred Hitchcock was known for making brief cameo appearances in nearly all of his own films, a habit that became something of a signature.
The special effects in the original Star Wars trilogy were largely achieved with physical models and practical effects, long before computer generated imagery became common.
Citizen Kane, released in 1941, is frequently cited by critics and filmmakers as one of the greatest films ever made, praised for its innovative camera work and narrative structure.
The word cinema comes from the Greek word for movement, reflecting how early filmmakers were fascinated by the illusion of motion created by a sequence of still images.
Pixar's first feature film, Toy Story, released in 1995, was the first full length movie created entirely with computer animation.
The Academy Awards, commonly known as the Oscars, have been presented annually since 1929 to honor achievements in the film industry.
Silent films relied on live musicians and title cards to convey dialogue and emotion, since synchronized sound was not introduced into feature films until the late 1920s.
A film's score is often composed after the movie has been edited, allowing the composer to match the music precisely to the pacing and mood of each scene.
The highest grossing films of all time are dominated by franchises built around superheroes, fantasy worlds, and long running science fiction universes.
Stop motion animation creates the illusion of movement by photographing physical objects one frame at a time and repositioning them slightly between each shot.
The Cannes Film Festival, held annually in France since 1946, is considered one of the most prestigious film festivals in the world.
Method acting, popularized in the mid twentieth century, encourages performers to draw on personal memories and emotions to portray a character as realistically as possible.
A film's runtime is typically decided during editing, where an editor works with hours of raw footage to shape a coherent story within a manageable length.
